items.text: In adults with low back pain and the clinicians who order their imaging, what do systematic reviews show about the effect of point-of-order imaging decision support, compared with no decision support, on inappropriate imaging orders, imaging volume, patient outcomes, override and equity?
items.population: Adults with low back pain; ordering clinicians in primary care and emergency departments
items.intervention: Electronic decision support at the point of ordering
items.comparator: No decision support or usual vetting
items.outcome: Inappropriate orders (primary); volume, pain and function, override, subgroup effects
items.time: Reviews published to the search date

finer: Feasible within 10 information specialist days and part-time reviewers; interesting to the procurement board; novel in handling overlap and quality explicitly; ethical with published data; relevant to the 2027 specification.
summary: One PICO question for an umbrella review.
